additional_info.subject: 0468306 - ID0468306-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370035] Error: RFID vs ext auth denied CRM:00472000494
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I have checked the logs from the event reported. In fact the first RFID tag scan is send and accepted by OCPP Backend. The user connect the car since we see a change of pilot state.
After there is a problem in SLACK communication (communication between EV and charger) so we don't start any session. Charging phase for authentication fail in a timeout.
The second problem is that the user tried again to authenticate with the same RFID but from the backend side there is already a authorized command for that idTag and block all the new requests. This generate a loop event where the user is constantly trying to authenticate and the backend is blocking the requests.
From the charger  point of view I don't see any fault. We can't be sure why the car didn't properly start the communication with the charger since we don't have any store logs for the event. The authorization process is managed by the backend and the charger worked as it should.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
